scope: Read-only availability audit of the frozen data; no alternative portfolio returns were evaluated.

monthly_window.count_unit: Policy-eligible, financially covered company-month signal observations, including initial deployment; not portfolio holdings.

fundamental_change.name: 12-month change in available accounting fundamentals
fundamental_change.current_snapshot: Current PolicyInputs signals after current policy/listing/financial eligibility.
fundamental_change.prior_snapshot: HistoryInputs.signals on the same input object at the calendar month-end 12 months earlier, with gate=False. This keeps the historical listing and financial source/freshness restrictions but does not require the company to have already been policy-eligible.
raw_changes: current ROCE minus prior snapshot ROCE
current negative cash-accrual ratio minus prior snapshot negative cash-accrual ratio
fundamental_change.cutoff_rule: Each snapshot uses only reports and arithmetic components available strictly before the first day of its own review month.
fundamental_change.ranking_rule: Compare raw metric changes, not changes in cross-sectional ranks. Peer membership changes must not masquerade as operating improvement.
fundamental_change.interpretation: This is a change between public-information snapshots, not necessarily a same-fiscal-period year-over-year comparison. Annual/interim mixtures and publication delays can change the fiscal periods represented.

price_momentum.name: 12-minus-1-month adjusted-price momentum available at the information cutoff
price_momentum.formula: For execution calendar month m: investor-currency adjusted price at month-end m-2 divided by investor-currency adjusted price at month-end m-13, minus one.
price_momentum.currency: USD for US portfolios; EUR for EU portfolios, using historical endpoint FX under the existing conversion rules.
price_momentum.listing_guard: The lookback start must not precede the candidate's actual listing or current-company start. Existing predecessor vendor prices do not make LIN or GEV tradable earlier.
price_momentum.policy_guard: Only current policy eligibility is required. A valid observed stock-return history before its policy admission can still be used.
price_momentum.execution_note: French's reference convention forms portfolios at the preceding month-end. This repository adds its existing wait to the current month-end execution; it does not claim identical execution timing to the reference portfolios.

fallback_policy.missing_feature: Keep the company's existing accounting score and explicitly flag the unavailable feature. Do not drop it from the eligible universe and do not assign a fabricated neutral rank.
fallback_policy.exit_deferral: Unknown improvement does not qualify for recovery-based exit deferral.
fallback_policy.same_period: If both public snapshots exist but refer to the same fiscal period, retain and flag the comparison. Calculate the observed raw difference; matching period labels are not automatically missing data.
fallback_policy.control: Feature availability must not change equal-weight membership or its NAV.

source_date_availability_counts.note: Gap dates and tickers match direct US.
Adds nine Alfen missing fundamental snapshots, June2019 through February2020, to the direct EU counts.

source_reference.title: Kenneth R. French Data Library: 10 Portfolios Formed Monthly on Momentum
source_reference.retrieval_status: Primary-source indexed text verified through web search on2026-11-15. Direct open timed out; corroborating primary pages also returned timeout/502. No full-page retrieval is claimed.
source_reference.verified_description: The indexed construction description uses prior2-12 returns and requires a price at month-end t-13 and a valid return for t-2.

limitations: The fundamental-change feature activates earlier in the US than in Europe because older EU financial snapshots were not recovered. Publish fallback counts and a later common-calendar subperiod readout.

Current annual/interim financial definitions and publication conventions remain as documented in the frozen source ledgers; changing available snapshots need not measure a perfectly comparable fiscal-year change.

The adjusted-price data are current frozen vendor histories, not a certified archive of contemporaneously available signal vintages. Historical FX is also subject to the existing data-source limitations.
Calendar subperiod comparisons are retrospective diagnostics; the already-inspected2023-2026 period is not a genuinely unseen holdout.
recommended_tests: Mutating financial reports published at or after either information cutoff must not change the corresponding earlier snapshot.
Changing the skipped latest-month price return must not change12-minus-1momentum; changing the permitted endpoint must change it.
Predecessor vendor prices before LIN/GEV listing must not satisfy the lookback; missing features must preserve base coverage and scores.
A new policy admission, such as TSM in2024, can use an earlier public financial snapshot even when it was not yet policy-eligible then.

implementation_review.status: PASS: read-only review; no portfolio-return simulations performed
checks: All four source-date definition/region feature-availability counts match this independent audit exactly.
Switching score mode from base to trend and back leaves cached base features and scores unchanged.
Prior financial snapshots bypass historical policy admission but retain historical publication and listing restrictions.
Momentum uses the specified lagged endpoints, portfolio currency and actual-listing guard.
Quarterly confirmation and one-review recovery grace do not consume future observations.
